notes.title: SYNTHESIS OF CORRUPTION: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Demo Version 0.5.1 (patch)
Changes:

Fixed 'mouse aim/sensitivity' issues when using very low 'look sensitivity' in-game setting combined with high mouse DPI value (this caused extremely bloated aiming with the mouse - it was such an edge case that I eventually got tired of hunting it down)

Tweaked gamepad stick behavior (this one's a bit tricky, Xbox controllers (xinput) might occasionally act up, but PS4 (DirectInput) controllers seem to work without any phantom stick input; if anyone reading this, please drop me some feedback about gameplay with controller, otherwise I'm just gonna blame Unity6 and not my coding skills :D)

Bumped up player movement speed slightly; still maybe slow though, it's survival horror after all (this change is meant to prepare for upcoming game levels and some future enemies - a few of them will be quicker than what you see in the current demo)

Adjusted weapon recoil (again!)


Thanks again to everyone who tried the demo ːsteamthumbsupː


Some dev news: the key rebinding feature is in the works, so it'll actually make it into the release! 

Who knew it would be such a pain in the ass (as if Unity's new input system isn't already! Heh, dev humor...sorry).

notes.title: SYNTHESIS OF CORRUPTION: Demo Updated
notes.content:
Demo Update \[v0.5] Patch Notes
Added camera (mouse) look smoothing option. Default is Off.

LMB now advances dialogue to the next line.

Minor tweaks to some interactions.

Reduced recoil for pistol and other weapons.

Improved ledge-grabbing distance. Better 3D platforming feel.

Pause menu now also opens with 'Tab'. '~' still works.

"Visor Implant" scan moved to 'Q’; (Key rebinding planned for full release: not prioritized yet).

Scene loading improved a bit (e.g., save room transitions).

notes.title: Demo Updated

 Axe (melee) rebalanced: faster speed/recovery, but lower damage

 Fixed decal bug on some dynamic objects

 Jumping and ground movement improved

 Adjusted physics object holding point
